data.name: Sallu
data.long_meaning: The name Sallu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sala' which means 'little mountain'. This name is often used in Hindu culture and represents the strength and stability of a mountain. It is also associated with the sun and the moon, symbolizing the balance and harmony in nature.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sallu is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is associated with the divine energy of the universe and is believed to bring strength, stability, and balance to the individual who bears this name.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Sallu has a life path number of 3, which indicates creativity, self-expression, and communication. Individuals with this name are often artistic, imaginative, and expressive.
